{{Top|leg}}
The '''501st Legion headquarters''' was the official base of the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] located in [[Galactic City/Legends|Imperial City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Within the headquarters it had a [[Special Operations barracks|barracks]] for the [[Imperial Commando Special Unit]].<ref name="IC 501st">''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''</ref>

*''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''
